shared.runtimeOwner: Shipped Godot code; skills describe the existing implementation and do not execute or install anything.
sourceContract: A sequence needs explicit supported ordering constraints; a dependency needs explicit labeled directed relationships.
Retain complete current prepared teaching, source text, exact UTF-16 citations and activity evidence.
Do not remove conditions, shorten source labels silently, invent scored relationships or execute source code.
The converter does not generate lessons. It projects already validated production content and rejects stale or oversized models.

upstreamFields: short source-grounded concept explanation and chunks
source-provided worked example with exact citations
activity title, instruction, explanation and hint
sequence items and stated ordering constraints
dependency nodes and stated labeled edges
safeAIWork.note: All upstream fields still pass production validators. The converter projects the complete accepted content unchanged; nativeTemplateId selects only an authored presentation.

engineOwned: Character identity, roles, portraits and pose transitions
World geometry, lighting, palette and camera
Phase order, control wording and source dialogs
Music playlist, crossfade, gain and cue synthesis
Evaluator, assistance state, awards, progress and atomic persistence

phaseContracts.gate: Accept the saved briefing before teaching begins. Objectives use the selected activity titles.
Read every prepared lesson before entering guided construction. Each lesson retains its exact source citations.
phaseContracts.entryCue: aster when moving through ideas; phase_complete when all ideas are saved

phaseContracts.gate: Complete the indicated guided placement/connection before Begin my own build. Rehearsal is cleared atomically for the challenge.
phaseContracts.entryCue: phase_complete after beginning the independent build saves

phaseContracts.gate: Commit a construction before comparing its stated rules. A failed save exposes no success or celebration.
phaseContracts.portrait: owen for sequence, claire for dependency; Aster mood changes only where Aster is rendered
phaseContracts.entryCue: correct for first completed nonfinal build; complete for first final build; retry after a saved incorrect attempt

phaseContracts.gate: All available constructions are complete. The interface shows saved source explanations and an optional ungraded reflection.
phaseContracts.entryCue: No automatic replay on restore; phase_complete only after saving a new field note

controls.sequence: Choose a module, then a numbered bay; direct seated controls remain available.
controls.dependency: Choose a starting node, target and supplied relation, then connect; direction and labels matter.
controls.review: Exact source text and prepared hints remain available. Revealing scored help persists supported practice first.
controls.navigation: Desktop pointer/keyboard/controller routes and station camera transitions are authored by the engine; skills must not invent controls.

animation.note: Stylized articulated geometry and procedural tweens; no imported photorealistic rig, video or GIF playback is promised.

audio.phasePlaylistRule: Phase track first, followed by the remaining full recordings in the setting playlist; three recordings are reused, not five distinct compositions.
audio.policy: Sound starts muted unless a saved enabled preference exists. Mute, focus loss and narration suppress cues; suppressed cues are dropped. No AI instruction can enable sound or change gain.
audio.nativeOnly: Production track/effect IDs are not native asset IDs. AI selects the native profile; its audio behavior is authored.

eventContract.action: select module/node or remove a connection
eventContract.visual: Selection UI; removal does not grant a reward.
placed: brief piece emphasis, nearest guide attention and rising ring
connected: moving link marker, guide attention and paired rising rings
success: nearest guide celebrates and setting-specific shards rise
mission_complete: all guides celebrate, debrief opens and progress scenery restores
Support pose and secondary-color ring; no loss of earned progress
Prepared source guidance; persist assistance before exposing scored help
Speaking pose and prepared contextual source hint after assistance saves
Restore saved world progress directly; never replay transient rewards

assets.asterIdentity: Preserve established Aster appearance. Owen and Claire are the authored supporting characters; no new identities are invented by generation.

accessibility.note: Reduced motion stops ambient motes/transient effects and makes poses/camera changes immediate. This does not certify complete assistive-technology support.

qualityGates: Explain each source idea before asking the learner to manipulate it.
Use one clear teaching idea per chunk; retain qualifications and exact supporting citations.
Describe only the controls and actors supplied by this runtime.
Never imply decorative scenery establishes a subject fact or real-world consequence.
Keep the distinction between independent and supported practice visible.
Generated pilot models award no official XP or mastery; exported pilot progress is local experimental practice.
Do not require AI while playing, infer general chatbot ability from prepared crew hints, or promise multiplayer in this runtime.

compact.name: Signalwright Operations Workshop
